below. See [Speed up with GPUs](../guides/gpu.qmd) for what is available today.

```{=html}
<div class="ref-facets">
  <div class="facet-bar" data-facet="package"><span class="lbl">Package</span></div>
  <div class="facet-bar" data-facet="type"><span class="lbl">Type</span></div>
  <input class="ref-search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search…  e.g. harmony or cellranger" aria-label="Search components">
</div>
```

:::{#ref}
:::

```{=html}
<span class="ref-count"></span>
<script>
function initRefListing() {
  var listing = document.getElementById("listing-ref");
  if (!listing) return;
  var tbody = listing.querySelector("tbody");
  if (!tbody) return;
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));

  // package name → facet colour CSS var
  var PKG_VAR = {
    openpipeline: "core", openpipeline_spatial: "spatial", openpipeline_qc: "qc",
    openpipeline_rapids: "rapids", openpipeline_composed: "composed"
  };
  // reference "type" → label shown to users
  var TYPE_LABEL = { module: "component", workflow: "workflow" };

  function cellText(row, cls) { var e = row.querySelector(cls); return e ? e.textContent.trim() : ""; }

  // 1) decorate each row: package → coloured tag, type → labelled kind
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    var pkgEl = r.querySelector(".listing-package");
    if (pkgEl) {
      var pkg = pkgEl.textContent.trim();
      pkgEl.dataset.pkg = pkg;
      pkgEl.classList.add("ptag");
      pkgEl.innerHTML = '<span class="swatch" style="background:var(--' + (PKG_VAR[pkg] || "core") + ')"></span>' + pkg;
    }
    var typeEl = r.querySelector(".listing-type");
    if (typeEl) {
      var t = typeEl.textContent.trim();
      typeEl.dataset.type = t;
      typeEl.textContent = TYPE_LABEL[t] || t;
    }
  });

  // 2) build facet pills from the data actually present.
  // Semantics per facet group (package / type), chosen to match how checkbox
  // filters usually work (Amazon, GitHub, …): empty selection = no
  // restriction from that group (everything shown); checking a value narrows
  // to rows matching ANY checked value in that group (OR within the group),
  // and groups combine with AND. Each group also gets an explicit "All" pill
  // that's highlighted whenever nothing else in the group is checked, so the
  // "unrestricted" state is always visibly obvious rather than implied by an
  // absence of highlighted pills.
  function makeAllPill(bar, onClick) {
    var b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "facet";
    b.dataset.value = "__all__";
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    b.innerHTML = '<span class="swatch swatch-all"></span>All';
    b.addEventListener("click", onClick);
    bar.appendChild(b);
    return b;
  }
  function makeFacet(bar, value, label, swatchVar, onToggle) {
    var b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "facet";
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    b.dataset.value = value;
    b.innerHTML = (swatchVar ? '<span class="swatch" style="background:var(--' + swatchVar + ')"></span>' : "") + label;
    b.addEventListener("click", onToggle);
    bar.appendChild(b);
  }
  var pkgBar = document.querySelector('.facet-bar[data-facet="package"]');
  var typeBar = document.querySelector('.facet-bar[data-facet="type"]');

  function wireGroup(bar) {
    var allPill = makeAllPill(bar, function () {
      Array.prototype.slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll(".facet")).forEach(function (f) {
        f.setAttribute("aria-pressed", f === allPill ? "true" : "false");
      });
      apply();
    });
    return {
      bar: bar,
      allPill: allPill,
      addValue: function (value, label, swatchVar) {
        makeFacet(bar, value, label, swatchVar, function (ev) {
          var pressed = ev.currentTarget.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
          ev.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-pressed", pressed ? "false" : "true");
          var anySpecific = Array.prototype.slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll(".facet"))
            .some(function (f) { return f !== allPill && f.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true"; });
          allPill.setAttribute("aria-pressed", anySpecific ? "false" : "true");
          apply();
        });
      },
    };
  }
  var pkgGroup = wireGroup(pkgBar);
  var typeGroup = wireGroup(typeBar);
  var seenPkg = {}, seenType = {};
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    var p = r.querySelector(".listing-package").dataset.pkg;
    if (p && !seenPkg[p]) { seenPkg[p] = 1; pkgGroup.addValue(p, p, PKG_VAR[p] || "core"); }
    var t = r.querySelector(".listing-type").dataset.type;
    if (t && !seenType[t]) { seenType[t] = 1; typeGroup.addValue(t, TYPE_LABEL[t] || t, null); }
  });

  var search = document.querySelector(".ref-search-input");
  var count = document.querySelector(".ref-count");

  // null = group unrestricted ("All" active or nothing checked); otherwise
  // the list of checked values (OR'd together).
  function restriction(bar) {
    var active = Array.prototype.slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll(".facet"))
      .filter(function (f) { return f.dataset.value !== "__all__" && f.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true"; })
      .map(function (f) { return f.dataset.value; });
    return active.length ? active : null;
  }

  function apply() {
    var rp = restriction(pkgBar), rt = restriction(typeBar);
    var q = (search.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    var shown = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var pkg = r.querySelector(".listing-package").dataset.pkg;
      var typ = r.querySelector(".listing-type").dataset.type;
      var hay = (cellText(r, ".listing-title") + " " + cellText(r, ".listing-namespace") + " " + cellText(r, ".listing-description")).toLowerCase();
      var vis = (!rp || rp.indexOf(pkg) >= 0) && (!rt || rt.indexOf(typ) >= 0) && (!q || hay.indexOf(q) !== -1);
      r.style.display = vis ? "" : "none";
      if (vis) shown++;
    });
    count.textContent = shown + " of " + rows.length + " shown";
  }

  search.addEventListener("input", apply);
  apply();
}
// Run AFTER Quarto's list.js has initialised the listing, so our decorations
// and default filter aren't clobbered. setTimeout(…,0) defers past list.js's
// own DOMContentLoaded handler.
if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { setTimeout(initRefListing, 0); });
} else {
  setTimeout(initRefListing, 0);
}
</script>
```
